spec_family.name: Exterior Fiber Cement Siding Repaint (Combined Assessment + Prep + Prime + Finish)
spec_family.description: Combined prime + finish repaint spec for previously painted exterior fiber cement siding (James Hardie HardiePlank, HardieShingle, HardiePanel) on residential homes. Covers condition assessment (visual inspection, ASTM D3359 adhesion test, chalk rub test, moisture probe, efflorescence scan, caulk assessment per 'Think Like a Water Drop' protocol), surface prep (low-pressure rinse ONLY — NO power washing on FC, mildew/algae biocide treatment, chalk remediation, efflorescence neutralization, degloss/scuff on sound paint, scrape/feather on failing/peeling, caulk removal and replacement), state-driven primer selection (chalk-binding for chalking, alkali-resistant spot prime on exposed bare FC at pH 13.0, acrylic stain-block for general RP adhesion, bonding primer for exposed factory-finished substrate), finish coat application (spray_backroll primary — departure from NC spray-only, brush_roll fallback), interstage inspection/sanding at QT4, final inspection and customer walkthrough. SF-based with ITM_SIDING_FIELD. 3 siding profiles (lap/panel/shingle), 3 surface textures (smooth/cedarmill/roughsawn). QT2-QT4 (QT5 excluded — utilitarian surface). Flat/satin sheen only. EPA lead-safe RRP module for pre-1978 buildings (rare for FC siding, introduced ~1987). First exterior fiber cement siding RP spec.

includes: Condition assessment (visual inspection, ASTM D3359 adhesion test, chalk rub test, moisture probe at joints, efflorescence scan, caulk assessment per 'Think Like a Water Drop' protocol) per elevation
EPA Lead-Safe RRP evaluation and containment for pre-1978 buildings (rare for FC — fiber cement introduced ~1987, but building structure may be pre-1978 with replacement siding)
Low-pressure rinse (400-600 PSI max with 40-60 degree wide fan tip — NO power washing on fiber cement). TSP at QT4. 24-48 hr dry time
Mildew/algae biocide treatment (common on north-facing/shaded elevations in humid climates)
Degloss/scuff existing sound paint (chemical deglosser or mechanical 150-180 grit) for SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT
Scrape and feather failing/peeling paint with carbide scraper + 80-100 grit feather-edge sanding for SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT and SS_EXT_PEELING
Chalk remediation pre-treatment for SS_EXT_CHALKING condition (chemical chalk remover on stubborn areas after rinse)
Efflorescence treatment (FC-specific — dry brush surface deposits + neutralize with dilute acetic acid, rinse and dry)
Caulk assessment and replacement at ALL siding-to-trim junctions (corner boards, frieze, window/door casings), butt joints, and foundation transitions per 'Think Like a Water Drop' protocol

State-driven primer selection: chalk-binding (SS_EXT_CHALKING), alkali-resistant spot prime on exposed bare FC (SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT/SS_EXT_PEELING), acrylic stain-block general RP (SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT/SS_EXT_PEELING), bonding primer on exposed ColorPlus substrate (rare)
Finish coat application — 1-2 coats (QT2: 1 coat, QT3/QT4: 2 coats per Hardie warranty). spray_backroll primary (2-person crew), brush_roll fallback
Interstage inspection and QT4 intercoat sanding (220 grit) between finish coats
Landscape perimeter protection (LF-based), hardscape walk/patio protection, light fixture/HVAC masking, vehicle/driveway overspray protection (spray_backroll, occupied home)
Final inspection, touch-up, protection teardown, equipment cleanup, site debris cleanup, customer walkthrough (RP-specific — occupied home)

excludes.route_to: SF_TRIM_EXT_RP_v1 (caulk at siding-to-trim junctions IS this spec's responsibility)
SF_WINDOW_EXT_RP_v1 / SF_DOOR_EXT_RP_v1 (window/door protection during siding work is their responsibility)
SF_SIDING_WOOD_EXT_RP_v1 (different substrate, different wash pressure, different application method)
Contractor — moisture SOURCE must be resolved before painting (gate condition)

excludes.item: Siding replacement or repair (broken boards, rot damage)
excludes.route_to: Siding installer — replacement boards use SF_SIDING_FIBERCEMENT_EXT_NC_v1
PROHIBITED on fiber cement — strips paint, damages embossed texture, forces water behind wall assembly

configuration_dimensions.description: Quality tier controlling inspection rigor, interstage sanding, prep thoroughness, and finish standard. QT2 is economy (single coat). QT3 is standard baseline. QT4 is premium.
configuration_dimensions.notes: QT5 excluded — siding field is utilitarian surface, not fine-finish millwork. QT2=economy single coat. QT3=standard 2-coat per Hardie warranty (baseline). QT4=premium with intercoat sand + systematic inspection. QT modifiers: QT2=0.85x (faster pace), QT3=1.0x (baseline), QT4=1.30x on binary coating tasks.

configuration_dimensions.description: Primary application technique. spray_backroll is primary RP method (departure from NC spray-only). brush_roll is fallback.
configuration_dimensions.notes: spray_backroll: 2-person crew, sprayer leads + backroller follows within wet edge. Adhesion benefit on weathered existing paint. brush_roll: fallback for <750 SF, occupied-adjacent, or high wind. spray (without backroll) NOT valid for RP. spray_backbrush NOT valid for FC siding.

configuration_dimensions.description: Finish coating sheen level. Flat and satin only for siding field.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Flat: default exterior siding sheen. Satin: acceptable for accent or premium appearance. Semi-gloss and gloss NOT valid for siding field — reserved for trim and fine-finish surfaces.

configuration_dimensions.description: Exterior substrate state classification driving primer selection and prep intensity.
configuration_dimensions.notes: 4 exterior RP substrate states. SOUND_PAINT may skip prime with verified adhesion. CHALKING requires chalk-binding primer (most common FC RP scenario). FAILING_PAINT/PEELING require acrylic stain-block + alkali-resistant on bare FC. Worst-state-wins per v1. Per-elevation if conditions differ.

configuration_dimensions.description: Universal 3-level condition scale driving prep intensity modifier. Maps from substrate state assessment.
configuration_dimensions.notes: GOOD=SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT (1.0x prep). FAIR=SS_EXT_CHALKING or SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT (1.5x prep). POOR=SS_EXT_PEELING (2.0x prep). Applies to prep tasks ONLY — never coating tasks.

configuration_dimensions.description: Siding profile type affecting production rates and material consumption.
configuration_dimensions.notes: lap=1.00x (baseline, most common). panel=0.90x (faster — large flat runs ideal for backroll). shingle=1.40x (slower — many overlapping edges, complex geometry). RP profile modifiers differ from NC (NC panel=1.10, shingle=2.00) because spray_backroll handles profiles differently than spray-only.

configuration_dimensions.description: Surface texture type affecting production rates AND material consumption.
configuration_dimensions.notes: smooth=1.00x (baseline). cedarmill=1.15x. roughsawn=1.30x. Textured profiles trap more paint in valleys, requiring additional spray passes and slower backroll for correct DFT.

paintable_items.name: Exterior siding field surface — net paintable area
paintable_items.counting_rules: Net paintable siding field area per elevation, excluding window/door openings and trim board faces. Measured from PaintScope PS_EXT_SURFACE_SF.SIDING_FIELD. Profile and texture modifiers adjust effective production rates — no separate item per profile.
paintable_items.notes: Existing item from SF_SIDING_FIBERCEMENT_EXT_NC and SF_WOOD_SIDING_EXT_NC_PAINT. Same physical surface in RP context. Single paintable item — all labor and material driven by SF.

variants.notes: BASELINE. Most common FC siding RP scenario on well-maintained homes. Degloss/scuff + 2 finish coats spray_backroll, no prime. Sound paint with verified adhesion.
Economy refresh on sound paint. Single finish coat spray_backroll. Minimum viable scope.
Standard RP on chalking or failing paint. Most common FC siding degradation scenario — chalking is primary FC failure mode. State-driven prime + 2 finish coats.
Full remediation on peeling FC siding. Heavy scrape + feather + alkali-resistant spot prime on bare FC + acrylic stain-block full prime + 2 finish coats. 2.0x prep modifier.
Premium refresh on sound paint. 220-grit intercoat sand, systematic raking-light inspection, premium materials (SW Emerald, BM Aura). No prime.
Premium remediation on chalking/failing FC siding. Full prep + state-driven prime + 2 premium finish coats with intercoat sand.
Economy RP on chalking/failing FC siding. State-driven prime + single finish coat. Budget scenario.
Standard refresh via brush/roll. Fallback method for <750 SF, occupied-adjacent, or high wind. Sound paint with verified adhesion.
Standard RP via brush/roll on chalking/failing. State-driven prime + 2 finish coats. Fallback method.
Lead-safe RP. RRP containment + 2.0x prep modifier + state-driven prime + 2 finish coats. Wet scraping methods. Rare for FC siding (introduced ~1987) but required when building is pre-1978.

material_systems_summary.name: Acrylic Stain-Block Primer for FC Siding Repaint
material_systems_summary.notes: RP-specific acrylic stain-block primer for previously painted FC siding with adhesion concerns. Spot prime for localized failure, full prime for SS_EXT_PEELING.

material_systems_summary.name: Chalk-Binding Primer for Chalking FC Siding
material_systems_summary.notes: MANDATORY for SS_EXT_CHALKING. Full surface application. Most common FC siding RP primer scenario.

material_systems_summary.name: Alkali-Resistant Primer for Exposed Bare FC (Reuse NC)
material_systems_summary.notes: Reuse NC system. MANDATORY on ALL exposed bare FC areas (pH 13.0 — saponification risk). Spot prime scraped-to-bare areas.

material_systems_summary.name: Bonding Primer for Exposed Factory-Finished FC Substrate (Reuse NC)
material_systems_summary.notes: Reuse NC system. Rare RP scenario — activated when scraping exposes original ColorPlus/ExpertFinish substrate.

material_systems_summary.name: Standard Exterior Acrylic Finish for FC (Reuse NC, QT2/QT3)
material_systems_summary.notes: Reuse NC system. Hardie-approved standard acrylic (SW Duration or equivalent). QT2: 1 coat. QT3: 2 coats per Hardie warranty.

material_systems_summary.name: Premium Exterior Finish for FC (Reuse NC, QT4)
material_systems_summary.notes: Reuse NC system. Premium acrylic (SW Emerald, BM Aura). 2 coats with intercoat sand at QT4.

module_summary.description: Landscape perimeter protection (LF-based), hardscape walk/patio, fixture/HVAC masking, extended landscape overspray (spray only), vehicle/driveway protection (spray, occupied home), equipment setup (spray_backroll or brush_roll)

Visual condition inspection, adhesion test (ASTM D3359), chalk test (white cloth rub), moisture probe at joints, efflorescence scan (FC-specific), caulk assessment per 'Think Like a Water Drop' protocol
Low-pressure rinse (400-600 PSI max — NO power wash), mildew treatment, degloss/scuff, scrape/feather, chalk remediation, efflorescence treatment, caulk remove/replace, dust/debris cleanup

State-driven primer: chalk-binding (SS_EXT_CHALKING), alkali-resistant spot prime on bare FC, full prime spray_backroll or brush_roll (SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT/SS_EXT_PEELING). Module skipped for SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT with verified adhesion.
Finish coats 1 and 2 by spray_backroll or brush_roll. QT2: single coat. QT3/QT4: 2 coats per Hardie warranty.
Interstage inspection, QT4-only intercoat light sand (220 grit), touch-up defects, intercoat dust removal. Module skipped for QT2 single-coat systems.
Final walkthrough inspection, final touch-up, protection teardown, equipment cleanup, site debris cleanup, customer walkthrough (RP-specific — occupied home)

stacking_partition.prep_pool: condition_scale x rrp x access x profile x texture (max realistic: FAIR 1.5 x no_RRP 1.0 x ladder 1.35 x lap 1.0 x cedarmill 1.15 = 2.33x)
stacking_partition.coating_pool: quality_tier x access x profile x texture (max: QT4 1.30 x scaffold 1.60 x shingle 1.40 x roughsawn 1.30 = 3.79x — under 4.0x cap)
stacking_partition.never_cross: Prep pool never includes QT. Coating pool never includes condition_scale or RRP.

protection_zones_required.notes: LF-based landscape perimeter protection. RP covers scraping debris and rinse water runoff in addition to overspray. RRP further upgrades to 6-mil poly.
Walkway protection. Canvas drop cloths for non-slip crew traffic.
Bag or tape over exterior light fixtures. All fixtures are installed and operational in RP context.
Full tarp cover HVAC condenser units adjacent to siding during spray operations.
RP-SPECIFIC. Occupied home context — vehicles and driveway require overspray protection during spray_backroll application.
RP-SPECIFIC. Ground protection below siding work zone for scraping debris, rinse water runoff, and paint drips. Active for FAIR/POOR conditions.
EPA RRP Rule. 6-mil poly extending 10 ft from structure. Per-elevation setup. Very rare for FC siding but required for compliance when building is pre-1978.

adjacent_surfaces.notes: Soffit at eave line. Often different color/sheen. Separate scope (SF_SOFFIT_EXT_RP). Light masking at siding-soffit junction during spray.
Frieze board at siding-to-soffit junction. Trim color. Caulk at siding-to-frieze junction is THIS spec's responsibility.
Corner boards frame siding. Caulk at siding-to-corner junction is THIS spec's responsibility.
Window casing. Caulk at siding-to-casing junction is THIS spec's responsibility. Window/door protection is window/door spec's responsibility.
Door casing. Same as window casing relationship.
Foundation below siding. Not in scope. Drop cloth protection at grade level handled by landscape/hardscape protection zones.

valid_input_states.notes: 4 exterior RP substrate states. Each drives distinct prep pathway and primer selection. Worst-state-wins per v1. Per-elevation if conditions differ.

output_state.notes: All input states normalize to SS_EXT_PAINTED_* after proper prep and coating. Flat is default exterior siding sheen.

adjacent_state_protection_rules.notes: In RP, trim is almost always already painted. Light masking for brush_roll, full masking for spray_backroll.
Soffit is almost always already finished in RP. Light masking at siding-soffit junction. Spray drift is primarily lateral/downward.

site_condition_rules.notes: HEIGHT IS A MAJOR MODIFIER for siding. Per-elevation attribute. ground=1.00x, ladder=1.35x, scaffold=1.60x, lift=1.50x.
Pre-1978 + lead-positive activates MOD_RRP_EXT_CONTAINMENT and FAC_FCRP_RRP (2.0x). Very rare for FC siding.
MC >15% is STOP WORK for coating. Active moisture = do not proceed until source resolved.
Common on north-facing, shaded elevations in humid climates.
FC-specific. Active/recurring efflorescence = STOP WORK until moisture source resolved.

cross_spec_coordination.deduplication_note: MOD_RRP_EXT_CONTAINMENT is shared across all exterior RP specs — do not duplicate lead-safe tasks when running alongside SF_TRIM_EXT_RP or SF_WINDOW_EXT_RP.
cross_spec_coordination.shared_session_note: FC siding RP typically runs alongside SF_TRIM_EXT_RP (corner boards, frieze, casings). Low-pressure rinse ownership per-elevation (U-004): FC siding uses 400-600 PSI rinse, NOT the 1000-1500 PSI power wash used by wood siding/trim — cannot share a wash pass. Landscape/hardscape protection shared (U-004): first spec in elevation sequence owns setup.
coordination_notes: Caulk at ALL siding-to-trim junctions is THIS spec's responsibility (not trim spec).
Window/door protection during siding work is owned by window/door RP specs, not this spec.
Height/access modifiers (FAC_EXT_ACCESS) are per-elevation attributes — one building may have different access types per elevation.
Vehicle/driveway protection zone is RP-specific — occupied home context. Shared with other exterior RP specs using spray application.
In RP, all adjacent surfaces (trim, soffit, foundation) are almost always already finished — protection is mandatory for BOTH spray_backroll and brush_roll methods.
FC siding low-pressure rinse (400-600 PSI) is a CRITICAL departure from wood siding RP (1000-1500 PSI power wash) and trim RP (500-1000 PSI). Different wash methods — cannot share pass.

research_corrections.original_claim: RRP modifier is 1.40x on prep tasks
research_corrections.corrected_to: RRP modifier is 2.00x on prep tasks involving paint disturbance. Calibrated to 2.00x based on actual wet-scraping, HEPA vacuum, and containment maintenance overhead per EPA RRP procedural requirements.

research_corrections.original_claim: Environmental conditions (wind, sun, surface temp, dew point) should be estimation modifiers
research_corrections.corrected_to: Environmental conditions are NOT estimatable — unpredictable at bid time. Excluded from spec entirely.

sequencing_notes.production_sequence: Setup (landscape/hardscape/fixture/HVAC/vehicle protection + equipment) -> RRP containment (if pre-1978) -> Assess (condition/adhesion/chalk/moisture/efflorescence/caulk per elevation) -> Prep (low-pressure rinse per elevation + 24-48 hr dry + mildew treatment + efflorescence treatment + scrape/feather + degloss/scuff + chalk remediation + caulk removal + dust/debris cleanup + caulk apply post-prime) -> Prime (chalk-binding full surface OR alkali-resistant spot on bare FC + acrylic stain-block full/spot) -> Finish 1 (spray_backroll or brush_roll) -> Interstage (inspect + QT4 sand + touch-up + dust) -> Finish 2 (QT3/QT4 only) -> Final inspect -> Touch-up -> Protection teardown -> Equipment cleanup -> Site cleanup -> Customer walkthrough
sequencing_notes.key_prohibitions: NO power washing on fiber cement (>600 PSI PROHIBITED — strips paint, damages embossed texture, forces water behind wall). NO skipping chalk-binding primer on SS_EXT_CHALKING. NO standard latex primer directly on bare FC (pH 13.0 — use alkali-resistant). NO caulking field butt joints on lap siding (moisture trap). NO painting over active/recurring efflorescence (resolve moisture source first). NO painting at MC >15% (STOP WORK). NO RRP without containment.

relationships.notes: First exterior fiber cement siding RP spec. Combined assessment + prep + prime + finish. NC sibling spec is SF_SIDING_FIBERCEMENT_EXT_NC_v1 (25 tasks, FCSD prefix). 12 DIRECT re-keyed + 11 MODIFIED + 17 RP_NEW + 5 SHARED_RRP = 45 total tasks.

SF-based with single paintable item. spray_backroll primary method (departure from NC spray-only). NO power washing — low-pressure rinse only (400-600 PSI max). 3 profiles (lap/panel/shingle), 3 textures (smooth/cedarmill/roughsawn). QT2-QT4 (QT5 excluded).
